statement:
TASK (design): choose the member sizes of the model below so that every design check passes with the least steel weight.
Structure: continuous beam. Mode tool-allowed: you may run the analysis tool (run_analysis) and read its results.
Sign conventions, axes and units are those of docs/CONVENTIONS.md; every number you give is in the units of the model file.

Only the sections of the members may change. Members that share a section in the file form a group; each member may take any section listed for its group (they need not stay equal):
  group I-500x200x16x10 (members B1): I-100x55x6x4, I-120x64x6x4.5, I-150x75x7x5, I-100x100x8x6, I-180x90x8x5, I-200x100x8x5, I-120x120x9x6, I-250x125x9x6, I-150x150x10x7, I-300x150x10x7, I-350x175x11x7, I-200x200x12x8, I-400x180x13x8, I-250x250x14x9, I-450x200x14x9, I-500x200x16x10, I-300x300x16x10, I-550x210x18x11, I-600x220x20x12, I-350x350x19x12, I-700x250x22x13, I-400x400x22x13, I-800x300x25x14, I-400x400x30x18, I-900x300x30x16, I-450x400x38x22, I-1000x350x35x18, I-500x450x45x26, I-550x500x55x32
The definitions of these sections are in the task under catalogue/sections. Weight of the model as given: 8.35619 kN; with the sizes as given at least one design check fails.
Criteria:
  feasible: the model with your sections is analysed by the engine, every AISC 360-22 member check passes (design status pass or conditional) and its reference passes the verification pipeline with the design results (benchfea verify --design)
